title: changeEnvironment
responsibility: Lists automatic deployment destinations in order, stopping at preprod even when prod is selected.

inputs.name: changeEnvironment.environment
inputs.description: The selected deployment environment. The function accepts dev, stage, preprod, and prod; any other value throws an Error.

outputs.name: changeEnvironment
outputs.description: Automatic destinations in promotion order. dev returns ["dev"], stage returns ["dev", "stage"], and preprod or prod returns ["dev", "stage", "preprod"].

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when the argument is not dev, stage, preprod, or prod; the message is "Unknown deployment environment.".
